title: glosa common definitions
description: tier: Dr (specified; independently unreviewed). Shared enum/shape definitions reused by every other schema/*.schema.json file via relative $ref, so a shared vocabulary (tier ladder, independence ladder, k_state, ...) has exactly one home per FOUNDATION_v0.5.md's one-fact-one-home rule (§8) even though JSON Schema draft-07 has no native cross-file merge. NOT itself one of the 20 schemas the task named; added because every one of those 20 references at least one definition here. Namespace https://glosa.example/ is a placeholder — glosa has no public domain yet (REPO_SPEC_v0.5.md: local Forgejo only, no public remote).

tier.description: FOUNDATION_v0.5.md §4.1 — six-value tier ladder, never collapsed.

independence_class.description: FOUNDATION_v0.5.md §4.2 — ONE string ladder I0..I5, chair ruling C1, reused verbatim by claim card, evidence relation, review report, citation card, kg edge, route dependence matrix. Never a numeric ordinal at schema level.

mc_level.description: FOUNDATION_v0.5.md §7.1 — MIMCG L0-L5 mapped onto glosa artifacts.

review_mode.description: FOUNDATION_v0.5.md §7.8, chair ruling C5 — SIX values, INTERNAL_DATA_AUDIT restored.

search_mode.description: search_log.yaml's search-episode label, kept a DISTINCT field name `search_mode` from `review_mode` (FOUNDATION_v0.5.md §7.8's verification-route label) — resolves the name collision S14_literature-review-system.md §12 open-question-1 flagged, per this task's explicit instruction. Same five-value enum content as the S8 template's field, renamed only.

fetch_status.description: FOUNDATION_v0.5.md §7.8, chair ruling C3 — ONE enum, reused by citation card and neighbour table.

citation_status.description: FOUNDATION_v0.5.md §7.8 six-value citation card status. Supersedes templates/knowledge/citation_card.yaml's older broader draft enum (that S8 draft also listed CLAIM_MISMATCH/FETCH_FAILED as status values); this schema follows the more recent, binding FOUNDATION_v0.5.md §7.8 text.

identifier_kind.description: FOUNDATION_v0.5.md §7.8, chair ruling C8 — adds BLACKBOX_NOTE.

genre.description: FOUNDATION_v0.5.md §6.1, chair ruling B1 — 9 rows + MIXED_GENRE.

venue_track.description: FOUNDATION_v0.5.md §3.2 / must-fix 8 — `none` legal for K0 work never headed to any venue.

release_status.description: FOUNDATION_v0.5.md §7.4 — one canonical release state machine name set.

gate_verdict.description: FOUNDATION_v0.5.md §7.4 PUB-ADVERSARIAL-REVIEW verdict vocabulary, one vocabulary reused everywhere.

study_design.description: FOUNDATION_v0.5.md §2 problem-first spine, empirical_extension (founder instruction 2026-09-04, BBL-2026-09-04-083/084) -- claim_card.empirical_extension.study_design.

robustness_what_varied.description: claim_card.empirical_extension.robustness.checks[].what_varied -- distinct from the independence ladder I0-I5 (who checked); this axis answers whether the result survives varying data/method/analyst/tool/time.

robustness_result.description: claim_card.empirical_extension.robustness.checks[].result. Comparison vocabulary only -- same/different/not_run, per AGENTS.md gate rule 6, never a novelty/priority word.

disclaimer_id.description: FOUNDATION_v0.5.md §5 — one master disclaimer catalogue; no id may resolve to a catch-all OTHER bucket, so a bare shape check (pattern) is all the schema layer can enforce. The catalogue's own content (which ids exist) lives in methodology/data/disclaimer_catalogue.json (kernel-enforced, not schema-enforced).

role_or_human.description: People by ROLE, not name, unless the founder's own name is used for authorship (the one named-attribution exception, kg_node.yaml's own rule).
